svg.title: Doi Inthanon PAGODA 50-DAY 2026: GPX profile, five aid stations and four cut-offs
svg.desc: A profile sampled from the official 2026 GPX of 3,990 points, with elevation tags from 813 to 2,149 m. The horizontal axis runs from 0 to 57 km; the vertical axis from 700 to 2,700 m. A dashed line marks the 2,565 m summit cited by the Thai Department of National Parks, which is 416 m above the highest GPX point; the graphic therefore does not show the track reaching the summit. Stations follow the official chart: B1 Mae Klang Luang School at 8.3 km with no cut-off, B2 Pha Tang Junction at 19.6 km with no cut-off, B3 Mae Uam Water Resource Management Office at 28.7 km with a 15:00 cut-off, B4 Mae Chaem Guard Unit at 40.1 km with 18:00, B5 Relic of the Buddha at 47.6 km with 21:30, and the finish at 56.7 km with 23:30. Marker elevations are GPX projections for orientation and not official station elevations. The official 57 km and 3,600 m figures differ from the GPX. The graphic is an editorial visualisation, not a map, navigation aid or race-day profile.

g.text: 官方 57 km / 3,600 m+；关门取官方时间图
五站 + 终点 / Five stations + finish
B1、B2 无关门；真正筛选从 28.7 km 的 B3 开始。
剖面按 GPX 采样；官方 57 km 与 2,565 m 是文本口径。
Editorial graphic · CC BY 4.0 · not a map or navigation aid
